reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is essentially a restatement of the well-known selective oxidation mechanism (Al, Cr, Si forming protective scales) and does not propose a novel, testable mechanistic explanation specific to high-entropy alloys, making it scientifically trivial rather than a new hypothesis.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is vague and the falsification criterion is circular; it merely says if the alloy does not form a protective oxide layer the hypothesis is wrong, but the hypothesis itself is that it will form one, so the test does not isolate a specific mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis offers no new insight or specific, testable mechanism for a researcher working on this question, as it simply reiterates the general principle of selective oxidation without addressing the unique aspects of HEAs.
